provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.

prompt: Repair snippets/discount-label.liquid. product.price is a nonnegative integer in cents; product.compare_at_price is null or a positive integer in cents. Only when compare_at_price is greater than price, output one span class=sale with text Save P% where P is floor((compare_at_price - price) * 100 / compare_at_price) as a base-10 integer. Otherwise output nothing. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/discount-label.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
